notes: Glitch XFX - XFX MODE, glitch and chip-arp textures. The SID layer's wavetable arp is on for all three voices and every key from C2 to C7 gets one of eight arp variants (triad climb, minor spiral, octave stutter, noise burst, fifth ladder, chromatic crawl, sync lead, ring bell) with its own speed, pulse widths and SID filter, while the Wavetable layer adds a different glitch / digital / metallic table on each key with its own filter and a short, sometimes repeating envelope. Hold a key to hear its arp.
